how: Move the pointer slowly onto the closed island, hold 2 s, leave; repeat quickly 10 times; probe island, mark each step

scenario: Voice view: open, listen, answer, close
how: Open the voice assistant (its shortcut or the mic on the island); say a short request; let it answer; close; probe island; film it
expected: Shape grows to the voice view with the content already in place, no clipping or teleport at the start or end, text and bot icon stay inside the surface, closes back to the closed shape without a leftover frame

scenario: Peek view: track change and timer
how: Start music in a player, skip tracks; start a focus timer; probe island; film it
expected: Peek content appears with the staggered reveal, nothing outside the surface, returns to the closed shape without a jump

scenario: Alert view: normal and critical alert, volume bursts
how: notify-send "t" "b"; notify-send -u critical "t" "b"; press volume keys quickly 10 times; plug/unplug a charger if possible; probe island; film it
expected: Alert shows (critical first piece after the surface starts moving, a frame of slack is acceptable), is not clipped, volume bursts coalesce into one smooth update, dismisses cleanly
headless_basis: alert_critical measured 130-134 ms stagger with one flaky judge (fixed to one frame of slack)

how: Hover in/out quickly, trigger an alert while expanded, open voice while an alert shows, close in the middle of each; probe island

how: Play music and start a focus timer so the split appears; hover; film it

scenario: Typing immediately after the shortcut (physical keyboard)

expected: No dropped characters, the results list follows the text, no visible stall, Search does not move while typing

how: Probe search while typing 100 characters; also film the entry at 240 fps and count frames from key down to the character appearing

scenario: Arrow selection and Enter on every row type
